mapper.select: SELECT FROM moment_comment c LEFT JOIN app_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM moment_comment c LEFT JOIN app_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.moment_id = #{momentId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moment_comment (user_id, moment_id, parent_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{momentId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW())
